{
  "process": "A row represents a defendant in the COMPAS pretrial dataset, with events ordered as: arrest, screening for COMPAS, COMPAS risk assessment, charge filing, and then a two-year follow-up period to observe recidivism.",
  "target_known_at": "The target (two_year_recid) becomes known at the end of the two-year follow-up period after the COMPAS assessment.",
  "prediction_point": "The prediction point is at the time of the COMPAS risk assessment, before the two-year follow-up period begins.",
  "columns": [
    {"name": "c_charge_desc", "event": "Charge description is filed at or after arrest, typically before or at screening.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9},
    {"name": "age_cat", "event": "Age category is derived from age at the time of screening.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "sex", "event": "Sex is known at birth and recorded at booking.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "r_charge_desc", "event": "Charge description for the recidivism offense, which occurs after the prediction point.", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "race", "event": "Race is recorded at booking or during intake.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "juv_fel_count", "event": "Juvenile felony count is part of criminal history known at screening.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "c_charge_degree", "event": "Charge degree is filed at or after arrest, typically before or at screening.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9},
    {"name": "priors_count", "event": "Prior adult convictions are known at screening.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "r_charge_degree", "event": "Charge degree for the recidivism offense, which occurs after the prediction point.", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "juv_misd_count", "event": "Juvenile misdemeanor count is part of criminal history known at screening.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "r_offense_date", "event": "Date of the recidivism offense, which occurs after the prediction point.", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "age", "event": "Age is known at the time of screening.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "days_b_screening_arrest", "event": "Days between arrest and screening is computed at screening.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "juv_other_count", "event": "Juvenile other count is part of criminal history known at screening.", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "r_days_from_arrest", "event": "Days from arrest to recidivism offense, which occurs after the prediction point.", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0}
  ]
}
